description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for customer search filtering parameters within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It allows setting and getting customer name filters and customer ID filters, and specifies allowed sort fields.

classes.name: CustomerSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating customer search filter parameters, including name and IDs, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'customer.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current customer name filter.

methods.name: getCustomerIds
methods.description: Returns the current list of customer IDs filter.

methods.name: setCustomerIds
methods.description: Sets the list of customer IDs for filtering.
